notablePrerequisites:
"Samurai" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
Oathkeeper attached to Filigree Familiar.
description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Kozilek.
Kozilek and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Kozilek trigger, shuffling your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Kozilek, putting it onto the battlefield and shuffling your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Kozilek's power.
Repeat.
